John,

Before I told you 8D was closed out I went back through it piece by piece so I'd be giving you the straight story, not what got said in passing. Short version: it's almost there, but there's one real item still hanging, and it's on your approval to clear.

Where 8D actually stands:

Done and verified (passed the final walk clearance, PASS):
- Hallway baseboard scuff and bedroom outlet cover — both punch-list items resolved
- Drywall repairs, kitchen faucet replacement, bedroom/living-room paint
- Carpet cleaning (Victor Rios) and full deep clean (Isela Juarez)
- Refrigerator swap — completed 6/25 (8D was run first as the critical path)

Still outstanding:
- Kitchen garbage disposal. When I ran Las Palmas on 6/22 I found it seized — motor won't reset, flywheel frozen — so it needs a full replacement unit, not a reset. I routed it to you for parts approval that day (OPS-227) before ordering. I can't find an approval, a parts order, or an install since, so it's still open. It didn't get caught in the final walk, which is why the unit looks done on paper. With a lease signing pending, I don't want to call 8D ready with a dead disposal in the kitchen.

What it'll take to finish:
1. Your go-ahead on a replacement disposal unit (routine in-house swap, roughly an hour).
2. I order the unit, swap it, and verify operation.
3. I close OPS-227 / MT-2026-1327 and flip the make-ready turn to Ready — at that point 8D is genuinely move-in ready.

I've already corrected the records so nobody's working off stale info: the make-ready turn is back to In Progress (it was showing Ready), OPS-227 is updated to reflect the full replacement, and I logged a maintenance ticket (MT-2026-1327) since the disposal wasn't in the system of record.

Give me the approval and I'll have it swapped and 8D closed out same day.

Thanks,
James

## The bottom line
**Don't call 8D ready yet.** On paper it looks finished — and almost everything is — but there's **one genuine open item that got lost: the kitchen garbage disposal is seized and was never replaced.** That's exactly the kind of thing that would've come back on you a week after you told John it was done.

## What I verified (not what someone said in passing)
Checked each piece against the source system, not the chatter:

**Done and confirmed** — passed the Final Walk Clearance (PASS, reports SPM‑2026‑MR‑8D‑FW/‑QC):
- Baseboard scuff + bedroom outlet cover (the two QC punch items) — resolved
- Drywall, kitchen faucet replacement, bedroom/living paint
- Carpet cleaning (Victor Rios), deep clean (Isela Juarez)
- **Refrigerator swap — done 6/25** (Airtable turn note + cross-referenced against the Rio Bend 214 ticket, where 8D was run first as critical path)

- Ran it to ground across every system: **no approval, no parts purchase in QuickBooks, no install, no Airtable ticket, and nothing in Slack after 6/22.** The Linear ticket was even mislabeled as a "clear the jam" and parked in "In Review." The 7/14 final walk never touched it — that's how the unit looks done. It's the one real blocker, and with a lease signing pending a dead disposal shouldn't ship.
